examples.speaker: CHRISTOPHER
examples.text: It's not true ― it's not true! You're all against me. Everyone's always been against me. You're going to frame me for a murder. It's persecution, that's what it is ― persecution.

examples.speaker: MOLLIE
examples.text: It's a disaster! Don't you see? You've left out the "S". Monkwell instead of Monkswell.

examples.speaker: GILES
examples.text: Good Lord, so I did. However did I come to do that? But it doesn't really matter, does it? Monkwell is as good a name.
